summary: Iteration 6 — TaxSimba Phase 1B UX retest. Backend: 114 passed / 3 skipped / 2 failed on the full suite AFTER Scenario D was driven live through Stripe; both remaining failures are the expected side-effects of the successful Scenario D run (Client B's MTD is now ACTIVE so a pre-existing baseline assertion flips, and test_taxsimba_phase1b_ux::TestScenarioC_Approve is a pre-existing fixture-ordering brittleness where acc_b tries to recommend on a case fresh_sa_client assigned to acc_a — unrelated to any iteration 6 change). Before Scenario D was driven, the same suite was 116 passed / 3 skipped / 0 failed. New /app/backend/tests/test_iteration6_retest.py (6/6 green) explicitly re-tests the iteration 5 HIGH bug and the send-offer alias. HIGH bug from iteration 5 is fixed: both POST /api/users (role=CLIENT) and POST /api/auth/register now allocate a client_ref (verified CL-0056..CL-0060 range) and immediately bootstrap SA ACTIVE on SMART + MTD NOT_ACTIVE, with /my-upgrade-options offering Elite at additional_amount_payable=£100 — no server restart needed. Scenario A on a fresh admin-created client: /my-offers empty, /my-actions contains no 'mtd' text, MTD service present but NOT_ACTIVE with no case. send-offer alias verified: POST /recommendations/{id}/send-offer sets status=APPROVED, creates exactly one offer, second call returns 400. Frontend: /recommendation/{offerId} now carries BOTH rec-explanation and offer-explanation testids (both resolve to 'MTD offer test'). Scenario D driven end-to-end via Stripe with card 4242 4242 4242 4242 (UK billing address, 'Save my info' unchecked): /payment/success displayed → MTD_INCOME_TAX now ACTIVE under Client B (CL-0043), /subscription shows both open-service-SELF_ASSESSMENT and open-service-MTD_INCOME_TAX, nav-mtd-for-income-tax visible, /mtd shows only MTD-2001 · 2026/27 · AWAITING_ASSIGNMENT (no SA leakage), SA dashboard still shows SA-1206 in progress, and admin All Cases page contains the new MTD-2001 case at AWAITING_ASSIGNMENT.

minor.issue: Pre-existing test brittleness: fresh_sa_client is assigned to accountant A but the test posts /cases/{id}/recommend-mtd with acc_b's token → 403 'Case not assigned to you'. Not a product bug; the recommend-mtd endpoint correctly enforces the accountant/case link. Fix should use tokens['acc_a'] or assign to acc_b.

Baseline test hard-codes MTD_INCOME_TAX == NOT_ACTIVE for Client B; after Scenario D was successfully driven Client B's MTD is now ACTIVE. Expected — Client B seed should either not be used for Scenario D or the baseline should be reset per run.

action_items: Fix pre-existing TestScenarioC_Approve fixture in test_taxsimba_phase1b_ux.py to use the accountant the fresh_sa_client case is assigned to (or re-assign to acc_b in the test setup).
Reset Client B's MTD service state (or scope Scenario D to a dedicated seeded client) so test_my_services_client_b baseline stops flipping every time Scenario D runs.
critical_code_review_comments: bootstrap_client_services helper is well-placed and reused from both POST /users and POST /auth/register — the previous iteration bug is genuinely gone. Good idempotency (client_ref allocated once, SA row added only if missing).
send-offer is now a documented alias of approve — clean and backwards compatible; second-call rejection is enforced via the PENDING guard in approve_recommendation.

offer-explanation lives in a hidden span while rec-explanation carries the visible copy — both are present in the DOM which satisfies automated testing but the hidden span duplicates text unnecessarily. Consider using a single element with the two testids on the same node (data-testid attribute + a wrapper).
MyServices route is /subscription in App.js but the spec (and older tests) sometimes refer to /services — worth aliasing or documenting.
Known carry-overs unchanged: CORS wildcard + credentials, no login lockout, server.py/phase1b.py size, MTD case_ref via count_documents.
